answer: Shared vault forfeiture. Each operator commits one vault whose contents back every identity it runs, so a sybil cluster is collateralized by a single pooled reserve rather than per-wallet deposits. When correlated behavior flags a cluster, the whole vault is seized and the operator loses the full reserve plus a voyage ban across all its identities. A crystal-clear audit trail links each identity to its operator, so evasion costs a fresh reserve for every new cluster.
